title: Content control values keep the prompt's style, and text() glues a block control's paragraphs
symptom: a value set on a control showing its prompt stays greyed out in Word, a line feed shows as a space, extra paragraphs stay empty, a combo box refuses free text, and text() runs paragraphs together
workaround: read a block control's paragraphs one by one with story_paragraphs: they are the entries whose location path is [i, 0], [i, 1]..., i being the control's index in story_items (index_path in Python)
